identity.name: Prospex 1965 Heritage Diver 39mm
identity.one_liner: The 2023 Prospex reissue with a textured "cement" grey dial that nods to the 1965 62MAS, and the 6L37 hi-beat 36,000 vph movement over the standard 6R35.

provenance_events.description: Seiko updates the 1965 62MAS reissue with a textured cement-grey dial, the 6L37 hi-beat 36,000 vph movement, and a 39mm case.

narrative.story: Seiko's Prospex 1965 Heritage line has gone from one reference (SPB143 in 2020) to a small family by 2023: 39mm and 40.5mm dive watches, all with the 6R35 or 6L37 movement. The SLA069's cement-grey dial is the only one in the family with a textured finish.
narrative.collector_notes: The 6L37 beats at 36,000 vph — same as the Speedmaster. 200m water resistance, 70-hour reserve.
